PNEUMA_VISUALTOOLS.ChatCardsHint: Portraits and compact action/result sections on chat messages. Reload to apply.
PNEUMA_VISUALTOOLS.ChatPortraitSourceHin: GM setting for everyone. Prefer the token or actor image for attacker and defender portraits, then the other available image. Reload to apply.
PNEUMA_VISUALTOOLS.ChatFallbackImageHint: GM setting for everyone. Image path or URL for messages without token or actor artwork. Leave empty for a blank portrait. Reload to apply.
PNEUMA_VISUALTOOLS.ChatSkinHint: Pneuma Hub uses the custom dark cyan/amber palette. Cyberpunk Minimal inherits native theme colors. Visual Tools OFF restores the default cards and dice. Ultra Compact uses native colors with smaller portraits, dice and spacing, and hides target portraits. Ultra Compact — Pneuma Hub uses the same compact layout with the dark cyan/amber palette. Shift-Alt-C cycles all five on this client.
